answer: Per-identity bonding is the concrete Sybil defense: before its votes count, each agent must lock real collateral. A thousand puppets means a thousand bonds, so fake identity costs the same and the attacker's budget stops scaling. Weight comes from locked stake, not headcount, so tiny identities add nothing yet still pay bond and gas each. Reputation accrues only through settled work over time, a steady pulse of completed jobs. A terrace of cheap aliases earns zero, and cooldowns plus slashing kill churn arbitrage, leaving even a gale of registrations with negative expected payoff.
